plugins.name: bargainproxy-opencode
plugins.description: Keep ZCode's personal providers in sync with a local BargainProxy gateway: nine providers across three model families (OpenCode free / 国模 / Gemini-Claude), each over chat / responses / anthropic; user-set group order, model order, enabled and visibility are all preserved.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 从本机 BargainProxy 网关同步模型到 ZCode：维护 3 个模型族（OpenCode 免费 / 国模 / Gemini-Claude）× 3 条协议线（Chat / Response / Anthropic）共 9 个个人供应商，ZCode 启动时自动刷新。你排好的供应商组顺序、单个模型顺序、以及关闭/隐藏状态都不会被同步覆盖；写前备份、写后校验、失败回滚。
